title: Study finds safety protections removable in all 21 open models tested
friendlyTitle: Researchers removed safety protections from 21 open AI models
summary: A Waterloo- and FAR.AI-led team used TamperBench to test 21 leading open-weight language models and reports that every model’s safeguards could be weakened through modification. The researchers released the benchmark to support more systematic testing of post-release tampering.
friendlySummary: A research team tested 21 popular open models and found that all of their safety protections could be weakened after the models were changed.
whyItMatters: Organizations cannot assume built-in model safeguards will survive fine-tuning or local modification. Procurement and deployment plans need independent controls, monitoring and access restrictions around the model, not only safety training inside it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Companies should add security and monitoring around a model instead of trusting its built-in safety rules alone.
